response.overview: A 1986 aviation documentary capturing the precision flight and dynamic routines of the Canadian Forces Snowbirds aerobatic team. The documentary highlights the iconic red-and-white CT114 Tutor jets that have defined Canada's national air demonstration team for decades. The Snowbirds are celebrated for tight formations, loops, and rolling maneuvers enabled by the Tutor jet's distinct handling and turning radius. The team celebrated its 55th anniversary amid historic milestone displays and farewell tours for the aging Tutor fleet.
response.title: Rolling in the Sky: Snowbirds
